test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Leo Tolstoy wrote many stories for children.

options.text: Many stories have been written for children by Leo Tolstoy.
Many stories were written by children for Leo Tolstoy.
Many stories were written for children by Leo Tolstoy.
Many children wrote stories for Leo Tolstoy

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Leo Tolstoy wrote many stories for children."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "many stories" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "wrote" to "were written" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Leo Tolstoy."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Many stories were written for children by Leo Tolstoy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Many stories have been written for children by Leo Tolstoy." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"Many stories were written by children for Leo Tolstoy." – Incorrect subject and object placement.
 
• **Option 4: **"Many children wrote stories for Leo Tolstoy." – Incorrect transformation to passive voice (remains active voice).
